name: Sakurazuka Natsuki
source:
[spoiler]It was at this time that she met onii-chan for the first time. It was also at that time that she found an [url=https://vndb.org/c10020]abandoned baby[/url].[/spoiler]

This is Natsuki in the year of 1996. There are two versions of her in the game when she is older: [url=/c10021]one from the year of 1999[/url], and [url=/c10013]one from the present[/url].
